# langsmith_issues (Data Source)

**Beta:** Lists issues detected in the current LangSmith workspace. The issue object shape is not yet stable, so each issue is returned as a JSON-encoded string.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Beta: list all issues in the workspace
data "langsmith_issues" "all" {}

# Beta: filter issues to a single tracing project
data "langsmith_issues" "project" {
  session_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "issue_count" {
  value = length(data.langsmith_issues.all.issues)
}

output "issues" {
  value = [for i in data.langsmith_issues.all.issues : jsondecode(i)]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `session_id` (String) **Beta:** If set, filters issues to the given tracing project (session) UUID.
- `workspace_id` (String) **Beta:** If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `issues` (List of String) **Beta:** List of issues; each element is a JSON-encoded issue object as returned by the API.
